name: Surah Al-Kahf
summary:
Experience the recitation of Surah Al-Kahf, the eighteenth chapter of the Holy Quran, in a deeply immersive virtual reality environment designed for Meta Quest.

This VR experience offers a calm and distraction-free space where you can listen to and reflect on the verses of Surah Al-Kahf. The carefully designed virtual environment and high-quality audio help create a peaceful setting for focus, contemplation, and spiritual connection with the Quran.
